hero._not: Banner: bitmis video (dikey tercih) + ondan cekim kareleri + ayni isin kaynak urun fotografi. Eslesen urun fotografi yok, foto yuvasi ikon olarak kalir.
hero.alt: Gelato launch video, a cup of roasted fig gelato flying over a tennis court

items.title: Fig gelato launch
items.desc: Launch ad for a roasted fig gelato. The tub is wrapped in tennis-ball felt and set on a grass court, with hand-drawn doodles, a splash shot and a balloon-letter end card.

items.title: Headphones spot
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for over-ear headphones, made to show the style and not commissioned by the brand. Splash and dust shots sit under each feature line, then a leather car seat holds the end card.
items.check: Marshall logosu ve 'The Major V' yazisi gorunuyor (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle yayinda.

items.title: Blender pro mode demo
items.desc: A presenter shows a blender's pro setting in 11 seconds. Two buttons, a smooth green smoothie, then the pour. Shot to look like a phone video for TikTok and Reels.

items.title: Watch exploded view
items.desc: The watch comes apart layer by layer while callouts name the specs: 28,800 beats per hour, fully mechanical, 9H sapphire. It closes on the assembled watch and the wordmark.

items.title: Rock to ring
items.desc: One unbroken transformation. A mossy rock cracks open, crystals grow out of it and the last piece turns into a solitaire ring.

items.title: Smoked chilli oil
items.desc: Ingredient story for a smoked chilli oil. Sun-dried chillies and seeds over hot coals lead up to the bottle floating in open sky.

items.title: Face roller how-to
items.desc: A presenter shows how to use a sonic face roller in 14 seconds. Upward strokes, the forehead, a light touch under the eyes. Filmed as a bathroom mirror video.
items.check: Senaryo kisisel deneyim iddiasi iceriyor ('changed my skin in two weeks'). Kullanici videonun kalmasini istedi; SSS cevabi ornek formatlari aciklayacak sekilde guncellendi.

items.title: Leash spiral
items.desc: A patterned dog leash coils into a spiral on a split yellow and blue set, then collar and leash sit together for the tagline. Five seconds, built to loop.

items.title: Diamond knot ring
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a gold and diamond ring, not commissioned by the brand. Macro shots on velvet and among floating stones, a hand-model close-up and an order-now end card.
items.check: Yuzukte 'Tiffany & Co.' yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle yayinda.

items.title: Calming dog treats
items.desc: Phone-style UGC for calming dog treats. The presenter sits on the sofa with an older golden retriever and holds the pack up to camera.
items.check: Videoda 'AI-GENERATED PORTFOLIO DEMO - DEEP MIST AI' bandi var ve kullanici Deep Mist AI'in kendisi olmadigini soyledi (2026-09-29). Baskasinin imzasini kirpip kendi isimiz gibi yayinlamiyoruz; kaynagi netlesirse crop ile acilabilir.

items.title: Necklace unboxing
items.desc: Top-down unboxing, hands only. The gift box opens on a paper-cut night sky and the key pendant is lifted out and laid on silk.

items.title: Collar and leash with a cartoon dog
items.desc: Close-ups of a collar and leash cut together with a hand-drawn dog that runs the walk route. Sniff and repeat pop up as animated type.

items.title: SaaS product explainer
items.label: Explainer
items.desc: A 73-second talking-head explainer for a platform that takes AI-built apps to production. The presenter is cut with screen recordings, big type and captions on every line.
items.check: Nometria urununu anlatiyor (gercek sirket). Kullanici kendi uretimi dedi.

items.title: Poolside serum
items.check: Kylie Jenner'e benzeyen model + KYLIE SKIN sisesi. Gercek kisinin izinsiz reklami (right of publicity): yayinlanmaz.

items.title: Court spot
items.check: LeBron James'e benzeyen oyuncu, Lakers 23 formasi, Stanley termos. Gercek kisinin izinsiz reklami: yayinlanmaz.
